setup_steps.text: Navigate to the Intuit Developer Portal at https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/homepage and sign up or log in.
setup_steps.label: Inferred
setup_steps.note: Based on developer sign-in wall observations and the Intuit Developer homepage URL.

setup_steps.text: Navigate to the App Dashboard from the developer console and click to add a new app.
setup_steps.label: Inferred
setup_steps.note: Standard app creation flow described in developer integration walkthroughs.

setup_steps.text: Select 'QuickBooks Online and Payments', provide your application name, and select the initial permissions.
setup_steps.label: Inferred
setup_steps.note: App creation steps described in developer guides.

setup_steps.text: Open the app's settings and add your OAuth callback URL to the 'Redirect URIs' field (e.g., your Composio callback or custom server endpoint).
setup_steps.label: Inferred
setup_steps.note: Required redirect URI configuration in developer settings.

setup_steps.text: Go to 'Keys and credentials' to view and copy your Client ID and Client Secret.
setup_steps.label: Inferred
setup_steps.note: Location of client credentials in the Intuit developer portal.

setup_steps.text: If testing, go to My Hub > Sandbox and create a Sandbox test company to retrieve your test Company ID / Realm ID.
setup_steps.label: Inferred
setup_steps.note: Standard practice for QuickBooks sandbox environment setup.

setup_steps.text: Paste your Client ID and Client Secret into Composio or your application configuration.
setup_steps.label: Inferred
setup_steps.note: Standard credential handoff step when configuring a custom OAuth application.
